snippet.title: PlayStation - Boundary Gate - Daughter of Kingdom (1997)
snippet.description:
DESCRIPTION
Boundary Gate: Daughter of Kingdom is a Role-Playing game, developed and published by Victor Interactive Software, which was released in Japan in 1997.
